verdict.rationale: Cline has a native macOS/Windows app that runs agent sessions in any folder (cline-gh-3). Visual diff review with inline comments and parallel agents in isolated worktrees are documented, but for the web-based Kanban board (cline-docs-5, cline-docs-24, cline-docs-47) and the VS Code/JetBrains extensions (cline-gh-1, cline-docs-30), not for the desktop app itself. Missing for 10: evidence that the desktop app offers visual diff review, evidence of side-by-side multi-session views in the desktop app, independent or hands-on corroboration.
